cause_quote: The hot reload rewrite removed `for (const channel of pluginReloadResult.activeChannels) { channelsToRestart.add(channel); }` and gated command-driven restarts on `previousRegistry.commands.some((entry) => !nextRegistry.commands.includes(entry)) || nextRegistry.commands.some((entry) => !previousRegistry.commands.includes(entry))`.
user_saw: After an unrelated plugin hot reload, Telegram plugin slash commands reported that they were no longer available until the Gateway restarted.
summary: The fix restarts native-command channels that had plugin commands in the replaced registry, even when those command entries are reused.
reasoning: I checked the parent code and confirmed that plugin hot reload already stopped attached channels before replacing the registry and restarted active channels afterward, so Telegram rebuilt its registry-bound command handlers. The rewrite skipped unchanged channels when command entries retained their identity, leaving their handlers bound to the retired registry. The September 16 change carried that restart rule into the extracted helper.
